How Webhook Automation works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can webhooks automate workflows between business apps?

A webhook is a message one app sends to another when something happens. In Noxtill, a webhook can be the trigger that starts a workflow: when another app sends an event, such as a form submission or an order, the workflow checks your conditions and runs the actions you set, like creating a record, sending a message or adding a task.
How does Webhook Automation software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

It connects apps that lack a built-in integration, so events in one tool start work in Noxtill without manual copying. When comparing webhook automation software or an API webhook automation platform, check for no code webhook integration, conditions and actions, support for the apps you already use, and a run history to review results.
